verdict.rationale: Consensus's own docs say it has evolved into a research agent that chains citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search and similar-paper steps on top of its search engine. It also offers Deep Search for more comprehensive literature reviews across many studies, which goes beyond a single-pass summary. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how the agent plans and iterates autonomously from a posed question, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-step investigation depth.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can pose a research question and get an autonomous multi-step investigation, not just a single-pass summary

citations.quote: Consensus has evolved from a search tool into a research agent. Citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search, similar papers, and more - chained together on top of the worlds best academic search engine.
Deep Searches (more comprehensive Lit Reviews across many studies)
Introducing: Consensus Deep Search 🔬 Literature Reviews in Minutes.
